title: Research: Entra agent identities with Azure RBAC, ABAC conditions and custom security attributes
goal: Answer with the kb tools first and official sources for the rest, writing facts through /kb-research and closing the agent-rbac UNK on agent identities and ABAC: Can a Microsoft Entra agent identity hold an Azure RBAC role assignment, and can that assignment carry an ABAC condition? Can custom security attributes be assigned to agent identities, and how do Conditional Access policies select agents by them? Which Microsoft Graph permissions and roles let an administrator assign those attributes to agents?
